description:
Investigate the end-to-end telemetry pipeline of a COS deployment: targets, to edge collectors, to the COS collector, to the backends (Mimir, Loki, Tempo). The pipeline rows follow each signal hop by hop, then the Collectors row covers the collectors' own health, the Backends row covers the datastores, and the High availability row checks that the COS applications are scaled.

Set the COS model variable to the model that hosts your COS applications; the High availability and Backends rows are scoped to it. The backend panels are global and are not affected by the Collector variables.

options.content: ⚠️ Set the "COS model" variable for your deployment. This dashboard is synced from git, so make changes in the source JSON and remove this row once your deployment is configured.

panels.description: Whether the COS deployment is highly available: every HA application runs two or more replicas. Degraded means at least one does not. Scaling guidance: https://canonical.com/observability/docs/latest/reference/topology/#cos

targets.expr: ((count(count by (juju_application) (up{juju_model=~"$cos_model",juju_application=~"mimir.*|loki.*|tempo.*|alertmanager|traefik|grafana|otelcol|opentelemetry-collector"}) < 2) or vector(0)) > bool 0) and on() (count(up{juju_model=~"$cos_model"}) > bool 0)

panels.title: HA mode

panels.description: HA applications running fewer than two replicas. Empty means every HA application is scaled. Scaling guidance: https://canonical.com/observability/docs/latest/reference/topology/#cos

defaults.noValue: Set the COS model, or all scaled

panels.title: HA applications not scaled

panels.description: Number of COS units in the COS model whose scrape target is down. Zero is healthy. Scaling guidance: https://canonical.com/observability/docs/latest/reference/topology/#cos
panels.title: HA units not reporting

options.content: End-to-end telemetry flow: targets, to edge collector(s), to the COS collector, to the datastore. Each panel: left axis = records/s or spans/s (accepted/refused in, exported/enqueue-failed/send-failed out); right axis = receive acceptance %. A break appears as refusals or exporter failures on the panel of the node where it happens, then the next node's accepted drops. Read left to right. 100% on every ratio = happy path.

panels.description: Log records per second for the edge collectors: the collectors closest to the targets. accepted/refused = Log records pushed into their pipelines; exported/enqueue failed/send failed = the hop to the next tier. Right axis: receive acceptance %. Shows the collectors in the Collector scope, excluding the COS model.
panels.title: Edge collectors

panels.description: Log records per second for the collector in the COS model, the final hop before Loki. accepted/refused = log records arriving from the edge tier plus the collector's own self-scrape; exported/enqueue failed/send failed = the hop to the backend. Right axis: receive acceptance %.
panels.title: COS collector

panels.description: Loki write path (distributor). received = log lines the distributor received (loki_distributor_lines_received_total); discarded = lines Loki dropped for any reason (loki_discarded_samples_total: rate_limited, out_of_order, too_far_behind, etc.). Right axis: acceptance %.
panels.title: Loki

panels.description: Metric points per second for the edge collectors: the collectors closest to the targets. accepted/refused = Metric points pushed into their pipelines; exported/enqueue failed/send failed = the hop to the next tier. Right axis: receive acceptance %. Shows the collectors in the Collector scope, excluding the COS model.
panels.title: Edge collectors

panels.description: Metric points per second for the collector in the COS model, the final hop before Mimir. accepted/refused = metric points arriving from the edge tier plus the collector's own self-scrape; exported/enqueue failed/send failed = the hop to the backend. Right axis: receive acceptance %.
panels.title: COS collector

panels.description: Mimir write path (distributor). ingested = samples the distributor received (cortex_distributor_received_samples_total); discarded = samples discarded for any reason, including sample_timestamp_too_old (cortex_discarded_samples_total). Right axis: acceptance %.
panels.title: Mimir

panels.description: Spans per second for the edge collectors, within the Collector scope. accepted/refused = spans pushed into their pipelines; exported/enqueue failed/send failed = the hop to the next tier. Right axis: receive acceptance %. Excludes the COS model.
panels.title: Edge collectors

panels.description: Spans per second for the collector in the COS model, the final hop before Tempo. accepted/refused = spans arriving from the edge tier plus the collector's own self-scrape; exported/enqueue failed/send failed = the hop to the backend. Right axis: receive acceptance %.
panels.title: COS collector

panels.description: Tempo write path (distributor). received = spans the distributor received (tempo_distributor_spans_received_total); discarded = spans Tempo dropped for any reason (tempo_discarded_spans_total). Right axis: acceptance %.
panels.title: Tempo

panels.description: Backend process restarts per application over the dashboard time range (changes of process_start_time_seconds), worst first. Red = at least one restart; all green means nothing restarted in the range. Change how many applications are shown with the Top N variable.
panels.title: Top backend restarts in range

panels.description: Resident memory of every Mimir, Loki and Tempo process, per unit. Container memory limits and node sizes are not visible (the cluster is not scraped), so there is no % of limit: watch the trend.
panels.title: Memory (RSS) per unit

panels.description: Streams held in memory by the Loki ingester.
panels.title: Active

panels.description: Chunks held in memory by the Loki ingester.
panels.title: In memory

panels.description: Chunks flushed to object storage per second, per Loki ingester unit.
panels.title: Flushed to S3

panels.title: Active

panels.description: Series held in memory by the Mimir ingester.
panels.title: In memory

panels.description: Blocks uploaded to object storage per second, per Mimir ingester unit.
panels.title: Flushed to S3

panels.description: Traces held in memory by the Tempo ingester.
panels.title: Active

panels.description: Bytes of live (not yet cut into a block) traces held in memory by the Tempo ingester.
panels.title: In memory

panels.description: Blocks flushed to object storage per second, per Tempo ingester unit.
panels.title: Flushed to S3

panels.description: Collector process restarts per collector over the dashboard time range (resets() of otelcol_process_uptime), worst first. Columns are Model, Unit and Restarts. Red = at least one restart; all green means nothing restarted. Change how many rows with the Top N variable.
panels.title: Top collector restarts in range

panels.description: Collectors with the lowest process uptime, which is the most recently restarted, up to Top N. Every drop to zero is a restart.
panels.title: Lowest collector uptime

panels.description: Collectors with the highest CPU usage (100% = one core), worst first, up to Top N.
panels.title: Top CPU usage

panels.description: Collectors with the highest memory use, worst by RSS first, up to Top N. RSS is otelcol_process_memory_rss; Heap is the Go heap in use.
panels.title: Top memory per collector: RSS and Go heap

panels.description: Items dropped by filter processors: incoming minus outgoing items per unit and processor. A non-zero line means the filter is dropping telemetry (by design or not). Check the collector's processor configuration.

targets.expr:
sum by (juju_model, juju_unit, processor) (${metric:value}({__name__=~"otelcol_processor_incoming_items.*",job="$job",juju_model=~"$juju_model",juju_application=~"$juju_application",juju_model!~"$exclude_model",processor=~"filter/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
-
sum by (juju_model, juju_unit, processor) (${metric:value}({__name__=~"otelcol_processor_outgoing_items.*",job="$job",juju_model=~"$juju_model",juju_application=~"$juju_application",juju_model!~"$exclude_model",processor=~"filter/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Filter (processor) (${metric:text})

panels.description: Sending-queue fill level (size / capacity) per unit, exporter and data type. At 100% new data is dropped.

targets.expr: max by (juju_model, juju_unit, exporter, data_type) ({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_queue_size.*",job="$job",juju_model=~"$juju_model",juju_application=~"$juju_application",juju_model!~"$exclude_model"}) / min by (juju_model, juju_unit, exporter, data_type) ({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity.*",job="$job",juju_model=~"$juju_model",juju_application=~"$juju_application",juju_model!~"$exclude_model"})

panels.title: Exporter queue usage

panels.description: The collector with the most otelcol_* series (the reference) plus the ones with the fewest, up to Top N. Read the lows against the top row: anything far below it has stopped reporting part of its self-telemetry. A collector that stopped entirely is absent from Mimir, so the metrics-missing alerts panel covers that case.

targets.expr: label_replace(topk(1, count by (juju_model, juju_unit) ({__name__=~"otelcol_.+",job="$job",juju_model=~"$juju_model",juju_application=~"$juju_application",juju_model!~"$exclude_model"})), "role", "highest", "", "") or bottomk($top_n, count by (juju_model, juju_unit) ({__name__=~"otelcol_.+",job="$job",juju_model=~"$juju_model",juju_application=~"$juju_application",juju_model!~"$exclude_model"}))

panels.title: Collector self-metric series (highest and lowest)

panels.description: Firing HostMetricsMissing / AggregatorMetricsMissing alerts, by forwarding collector and alert name. A high count means that collector's consumers' data is not reaching the backend.
panels.title: Firing "metrics missing" alerts, by forwarding collector
